marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Competitiveness and the Future of the High-Tech Industry

The US high-tech industry faces considerable challenges today in spite of a recent upswing in jobs and exports. Betty Baker presents statistics thar detail the failure of our education system to meet current demands for highly skilled workers, especailly those with the critical thinking skills of math and science. She also pinpoints government policies that put us at a disadvantage in global trade and R&D, while affirming her belief that concerted action now can reverse negative trends and help put the US economy back on track
